scope: Full 18-file PR source review; GitHub integration only. No product execution.
verdict: Changes requested: additional MEDIUM source-derived import record identity defect, plus inherited LOW wording.

finding.cause: Reader enumerates returned raw records without retaining requested id. parseJob checks valid id format only; importRow validates shape/counts, not identity. A well-shaped same-store B record at indexed A is returned as known B, replacing A in supposedly complete history.

synthetic_case.source_derived_result: storeImportsRead returns known jobs:[B], ids:1; importRow accepts B; importsTool sends B with found:true. This was NOT executed.
synthetic_case.expected: unknown, no imports rows, keep full hold

finding.remedy: Associate each raw position with ids[index], reject job.id !== ids[index] before foreign-store filtering; preserve exact nil omission and requested-id controls.
finding.sibling_pattern: readStored uses same parseJob without id equality (inherited, not a new whole-repository audit); author/C1 coordinate common cause.

prior_findings.shape: Closed by source: importRow requires record containers, safe nonnegative counts/times and own enum membership.
prior_findings.optional_counts: Closed by source: absent contacts/stopped become null; malformed values rejected.
prior_findings.wording_low: Inherited C4A6787121945: bundleChoicesTool JSDoc same order while MCP uses creator order. Not downgraded or silently fixed.

limitations.runtime: ZERO new checks/Redis/HTTP/provider executions. Proposed regression persisted but NOT RUN, no RED/GREEN claim.
limitations.financial: Reviewed payment-before-read and settlement-before-send flow and bounded command/page envelope in source only. No native Redis/provider/dollar global MR certification.
limitations.ci_verdict: Only 5 aggregators visible, 2 success and 3 queued. Not 9.
